description: Put a domain behind Nemesis Edge, the positive-security network/DNS layer (a Cloudflare-like edge that learns per-tenant normal). Returns the nameservers to delegate to, or a TXT record to publish if the domain already exists on the platform. Requires NEMESIS_API_KEY.

domain.description: The domain/apex to protect, e.g. example.com

name: nemesis_provision_edge
